Understand what is available

90 reference entries: 22 native recipes, 4 foundation routes, 64 planned enhancements. Reviewed 2026-10-16.

Native recipes are platform building blocks, not feature parity. Foundation routes use existing Husk primitives. Planned names are proposals, not registered elements. Release evidence is tracked separately.

Button — Native recipe · Phase 1

Actions · button; a[href]

Use buttons for actions and anchors for navigation; preserve submit, disabled, and accessible names.

Acceptance work: Enter/Space, focus, submitter, loading feedback, and disabled behavior.

<button type="submit">Save project</button>
<a href="/projects">View projects</a>

Reference component · Specification template

Button Group — Foundation · Phase 1

Actions · h-cluster with native buttons

Group related actions; use a labelled group when context needs it. A cluster is not an ARIA toolbar.

Acceptance work: Wrapping, long labels, independent Tab stops; add roving focus only in a separately specified toolbar.

<h-cluster role="group" aria-label="Project actions">
  <button type="submit">Save project</button>
  <a href="/projects">Cancel</a>
</h-cluster>

Reference component · Specification template

Copy Button — Planned · Phase 2

Actions · h-copy with button (proposed)

Copy an explicit source on user activation; retain selectable source text and visible feedback.

Acceptance work: Clipboard denial, secure-context availability, repeated activation, and polite success/failure announcements.

No runnable Husk component yet. This is a proposed contract.

Reference component · Specification template
